purpose: Teach: 砂利/空き地/ニキビ/小指/左下/レディース/インナー/レザー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが砂利道を歩く時はゆっくりだって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad mentioned that he walks slowly on gravel paths.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Soft delivery of a small detail shared between parent and child. Not lecturing — simply passing along something she noticed he learned. Gentle smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと近所の空き地で遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I played with Dad at the empty lot near our house.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. A child sharing something that mattered. Open and unguarded. Quick pace, warm eye contact implied in the voice. Wanting her to understand it was good.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ニキビは清潔が一番」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad told me that keeping your skin clean is the most important thing for acne.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant tone — not lost in thought, but clearly turning something over. The voice of a mother processing what her partner teaches their son. Quiet and reflective, not seeking agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに小指のキズを手当てして頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad helped me clean and bandage the cut on my little finger.
lines.style: Sincere, straightforward delivery. A child reporting something important that happened — a moment of care. Not exaggerated. Warmth underneath, but grounded in the fact itself. Small steadiness in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「画面の左下のロゴを見ろ」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad showed me how to look at the logo in the lower left corner of the screen.
lines.style: Gentle, passing-along-knowledge tone. The voice of someone sharing a small teaching moment. Not urgent. Reflective and warm, like she's still thinking about why he thought to teach that.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとレディースコーナーでママのお誕生日プレゼントを選んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I picked out your birthday present together in the women's section.
lines.style: Proud, bright delivery. A child holding a small secret with joy. Warm anticipation in the pacing. Quick and eager, but not breathless — savoring the moment of having helped choose something special.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがインナーを重ね着して下さるとあったかいわ
lines.en: Sho, it's so warm when Dad layers his thermal shirts.
lines.style: Soft, intimate observation. The voice of a mother noticing small comforts, small kindnesses. Quiet contentment. Not addressing the child directly now — more like thinking aloud about someone she loves. Trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんからレザーの財布を頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad gave me a leather wallet.
lines.style: Excited and proud, but controlled — not shouting. A child reporting a gift as a mark of being grown-up enough for something real. Warm gratitude underneath. Slight breathlessness at the end, like he's still holding the weight of it.
